item.title: Author's Notes
item.content:encoded:
I originally posted this several weeks ago on 4chan's /x/ under one of my other pseudonyms, "Dr.Ed".

This story is, believe it or not, completely true. I've changed the names of my friends, for propriety's sake, and of course added some fancy language here and there, but the tale itself actually happened to me several years ago. As of today, Evan and Kevin deny that anything paranormal happened that night. Rebecca still refuses to talk about it. As for me? I'm not sure what to believe. But this was my first and thankfully only brush with something that defied rational explanation.

Comments/critiques are welcome, as always.
